crossRefs.note: On the seventh day, when the heart of the king was merry with wine, he commanded Mehuman, Biztha, Harbona, Bigtha, and…
Moreover Yahweh said, “Because the daughters of Zion are arrogant, and walk with outstretched necks and flirting eyes…
Belshazzar, while he tasted the wine, commanded that the golden and silver vessels which Nebuchadnezzar his father had…
But when Herod’s birthday came, the daughter of Herodias danced among them and pleased Herod.

parallels.note: But when Herod’s birthday came, the daughter of Herodias danced among them and pleased Herod.

people.name: Herod
people.line: Tetrarch of Galilee during Jesus' ministry.

people.name: Herodias
people.line: Wife of Herod Antipas who had John beheaded.

translations.web: When the daughter of Herodias herself came in and danced, she pleased Herod and those sitting with him. The king said to the young lady, “Ask me whatever you want, and I will give it to you.”
translations.bsb: When the daughter of Herodias came and danced, she pleased Herod and his guests, and the king said to the girl, “Ask me for whatever you wish, and I will give it to you.”
translations.kjv: And when the daughter of the said Herodias came in, and danced, and pleased Herod and them that sat with him, the king said unto the damsel, Ask of me whatsoever thou wilt, and I will give it thee.
translations.asv: and when the daughter of Herodias herself came in and danced, she pleased Herod and them that sat at meat with him; and the king said unto the damsel, Ask of me whatsoever thou wilt, and I will give it thee.
